reason: The cited evidence directly shows 17–680× higher OER currents for the high-entropy perovskite versus single B-site perovskites on the (001) facet, and attributes this to multication composition and tunable active sites, but does not provide specific evidence for the claimed synergistic interactions, mixed oxidation states, or tailored adsorption energetics.
premises: Multiple B-site metals in high-entropy perovskite create synergistic interactions and mixed oxidation states
These interactions tailor adsorption–desorption energetics of OER intermediates
This leads to OER current densities 17–680 times higher than single B-site perovskites
The effect is intrinsic to the (001) facet, not due to geometry or morphology
